Are you looking for a portable Apple CarPlay screen with a built-in dash cam that you can install on your dashboard without replacing your car's stereo?

These devices typically offer:

Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

Front dash camera for recording while driving

Rear camera for reversing or rear recording

7-inch, 9-inch, or 10.26-inch touchscreen

Easy installation using a dashboard mount and 12V power outlet

A key distinction: some models include a rear parking camera but don't continuously record rear footage. If you want front and rear dash cam recording, look for dual-channel recording.
